contest.text:
The villagers of the Southern Shore celebrate the work that helped their settlement survive. Competitors display their creations near the village center while elders tell the children how much knowledge was once lost.
The contestants retell the settlers' history. One recitation is accurate; the other contains an embarrassing accidental insult to a revered elder.
